effect: The second fin completed the whale and all chapter goals.
reaction: A clear finish, though the result name gives little sense of the finished shape.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the second fin finished the whale; seeing the separate parts come together was the most satisfying moment.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the second side felt repetitive, though a whale needs both sides.

surprise.text: The assembly changed its name from Whale to Whale carrier after the tail was fitted, then back to Whale after a fin.

arbitrary.text: Choosing between the numbered sides or fins felt arbitrary because there was no apparent difference between the offered choices.

continue.text: Probably not personally: the physical assembly is clear, but this text-only chapter offered little variation or meaningful choice.
